run_img2img_pipeline: run the Kandinsky3Img2ImgPipeline to generate an image from a prompt and input image with strength control
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into T5 text embeddings with optional negative prompt and classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_from_image: prepare latent representations from an input image by encoding with MoVQ and adding scheduler noise
compute_timesteps_for_strength: compute the denoising timesteps and adjusted step count based on the strength parameter for img2img
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate all input arguments including prompt, embeddings, attention masks, and callback settings
